Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.auth

Interface ApiKeyRepository

All Known Implementing Classes:
ApiKeyRepositoryAdapter
public interface ApiKeyRepository
Domain repository port for the ApiKey aggregate (design §4.1).

Pure Java — no Spring annotations. The adapter implementing this interface lives under infrastructure/persistence/adapter/ and bridges to Spring Data JPA.

Only the operations consumed by EPIC-04 are declared here. listAll(com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.shared.Cursor, int) supports the cursor-paginated admin listing (US-04-007) with ordering (created_at DESC, client_id DESC) so newest API keys come first. updateDisabled(com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.auth.ClientId, boolean) backs the partial-update path of US-04-008 without having to round-trip the BCrypt hash through the domain.

    • listAll

      Page<ApiKey> listAll(Cursor cursor, int pageSize)
      Returns one page of API keys in descending (createdAt, clientId) order. Pass cursor = null for the first page. pageSize is the maximum number of items in the returned page; the adapter is responsible for detecting the presence of a next page and emitting a non-null Page.nextCursor() accordingly.

    • updateDisabled

      void updateDisabled(ClientId clientId, boolean disabled)
      Partial update of the disabled flag for the API key identified by clientId. Used by US-04-008 to avoid materializing the full aggregate (and notably its BCrypt hash) on a soft-revoke / re-enable.
